cause: Smooth custom-normal interpolation crosses the analytic flat-to-roll boundary on otherwise valid triangles. Height-error tolerance alone does not constrain normal interpolation. Two Natural hook vertex normals were also incorrectly sign-flipped by an averaged-geometric-normal heuristic.
overlapOrTJunctionEvidence: The assembled source derivative is watertight, winding-consistent and duplicate-face-free; exported triangle multisets equal prepared ones. The diagnosed flat triangle is part of the one constrained front graph triangulation.
shadowControl: Artifacts persisted when all mesh shadow visibility was disabled. This diagnostic control is not a shipping material or render change.
correction: Explicit flat/roll/floor shared breaklines and64 bounded transverse analytic section bands. Original cubic depth field, smooth analytic normals and contact labels preserved. Independent interior/edge normal interpolation checks require <=0.5degree. Explicit front/back normal direction removes heuristic flips. Rejected adaptive-normal subdivision is not shipped.

rejectedExperiment.reason: Normal-error-only subdivision reached iteration ceiling and density grew without convergence.
